main_text.p: Βοιωτοὶ. ὥσπερ τὴν ἡμῶν ἀπαγορευόντων· μηδὲ τοὺς τὴν ἄλλων πατρίδος ἡσυχῶς λέγειν [?] τετελευτηκότας [?]. Si quis in hanc Legem commisisset, in eum dabatur ἔνδειξις. Suidas: ἐπὶ τὴν κακῶς λέγοντα τοὺς τετελευτηκότας ἀδίκως, σκώψαντα δ᾽ [?] βουλόμενος τὴν πολιτείαν [?]. quibus e verbis, dicam impingi potuisse ab eo Atheniensium, cui liberet, discimus. Itaque veteres, ut scribit Plinius Lib. XXVIII. cap. II. ad men-tionem defunctorum testabantur, memoriam eorum à se non sollicitari.

page.notes: The Greek lines are small and blurred; the words marked [?] and the first part of the second Greek line are uncertain and may be misread. The ornament below the text is a woodcut with no printed text. The Google watermark at the bottom right is not part of the page and is omitted.
